options.content:
**Regelleistung.net** (German balancing market platform, crawler `regelleistung`, schema `regelleistung`). Tender data of the four reserve products:

* **FCR** frequency containment reserve (joint auction DE/AT/NL/BE/FR/CH/DK/SI/CZ, 4 h blocks, price EUR/MW)
* **aFRR / mFRR** automatic / manual frequency restoration reserve. `*_regelleistung` = capacity tender (blocks `POS_08_12`, ...), `*_regelarbeit` = energy market (15 min products `POS_001` ... `POS_096`)
* **ABLA** interruptible loads
* Per product three table kinds: `bedarfe` (demand), `ergebnisse` (aggregated results), `anonyme_ergebnisse` (every bid anonymised).

Times are UTC; `delivery_date` columns are local calendar days. Capacity prices are as published (EUR/MW resp. EUR/MWh per MW and hour). The anonymised tables are huge (up to 175 M rows) and are always filtered by time.

panels.title: FCR price (DE)

targets.rawSql: select avg(settlementcapacity_price_eur_mw) as v from regelleistung.fcr_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='DE'

panels.description: Mean FCR settlement capacity price per 4 h block (uniform across the joint auction).

panels.title: FCR demand (DE)

targets.rawSql: select avg(demand_mw) as v from regelleistung.fcr_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='DE'

panels.description: Mean FCR demand for Germany.

panels.title: aFRR capacity price POS (DE)

targets.rawSql: select avg(average_capacity_price_eur_mwh) as v from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='DE' and product like 'POS%'

panels.description: Mean average capacity price of positive aFRR products in Germany.

panels.title: aFRR capacity price NEG (DE)

targets.rawSql: select avg(average_capacity_price_eur_mwh) as v from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='DE' and product like 'NEG%'

panels.description: Mean average capacity price of negative aFRR products in Germany.

panels.title: mFRR capacity price POS (DE)

targets.rawSql: select avg(average_capacity_price_eur_mwh) as v from regelleistung.mfrr_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='DE' and product like 'POS%'

panels.description: Mean average capacity price of positive mFRR products in Germany.

panels.title: ABLA price

targets.rawSql: select avg(average_capacity_price_eur_mwh) as v from regelleistung.abla_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from)

panels.description: Mean capacity price of the interruptible loads tender (ABLA).

panels.title: FCR capacity price ($fcr_area)

targets.rawSql: select date_from as time, product as metric, settlementcapacity_price_eur_mw as "EUR/MW" from regelleistung.fcr_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$fcr_area' order by 1,2

panels.description: Settlement price of the FCR auction (EUR/MW) per 4 h block (NEGPOS = symmetric product), one line per block of the day. Block names are in local time.

panels.title: FCR demand by country

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), area as metric, avg(demand_mw) as "MW" from regelleistung.fcr_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area <> 'CROSSBORDER' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Share of the FCR demand per participating country (mean over the interval). Area CROSSBORDER (volume traded across borders) is left out.

panels.title: FCR deficit / surplus in country ($fcr_area)

targets.rawSql: select date_from as time, deficit_surplus_mw as "deficit (-) / surplus (+) MW", demand_mw as "demand MW" from regelleistung.fcr_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$fcr_area' order by 1

panels.description: Difference between demand and domestically procured volume: the part of the demand that is covered from (or sold to) other countries (column deficit_surplus_mw).

panels.title: FCR allocated capacity by country (from all bids)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), area as metric, sum(allocated_capacity_mw)/nullif(count(distinct date_from),0) as "MW" from regelleistung.fcr_anonyme_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Allocated FCR volume per country of the provider (area of the bid), taken from the anonymised bid lists. Mean over the 4 h blocks of the interval.

panels.title: FCR price by block of day ($fcr_area)

targets.rawSql: select product as block, avg(settlementcapacity_price_eur_mw) as "EUR/MW" from regelleistung.fcr_ergebnisse where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$fcr_area' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Mean settlement price by 4 h block (NEGPOS_00_04 = 00:00-04:00 local time).

panels.title: aFRR capacity price $area - $dir products

targets.rawSql: select date_from as time, product as metric, average_capacity_price_eur_mwh as "average price" from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$area' and product like '$dir%' order by 1,2

panels.description: Average capacity price of the aFRR tender per 4 h block (EUR/MW as published) for direction POS (upward) or NEG (downward) selected in the variable 'direction'. One line per block of the day.

panels.title: aFRR price level: min / average / marginal ($area, $dir)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), avg(min_capacity_price_eur_mwh) as "min", avg(average_capacity_price_eur_mwh) as "average", avg(marginal_capacity_price_eur_mwh) as "marginal" from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$area' and product like '$dir%' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Lowest accepted, volume-weighted average and marginal (highest accepted) capacity price, averaged over all blocks of the interval. A big gap between average and marginal price indicates a steep merit order.

panels.title: aFRR demand vs offered capacity ($area, $dir)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), avg(demand_mw) as "demand" from regelleistung.afrr_bedarfe_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$area' and product like '$dir%' group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), avg(sum_of_offered_capacity_mw) as "offered" from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$area' and product like '$dir%' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Demand to be procured against the total capacity offered by the bidders (mean over blocks). The ratio shows how competitive the tender was.

panels.title: aFRR allocated volume by providing country ($dir)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), avg(germany_allocated_volume_mw) as "Germany", avg(austria_allocated_volume_mw) as "Austria", avg(czech_republic_allocated_volume_mw) as "Czech Republic" from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='TOTAL' and product like '$dir%' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Allocated aFRR capacity by the country where it is provided (cooperation of DE, AT and CZ), mean over blocks.

panels.title: aFRR accepted capacity by capacity price ($area, $dir)

targets.rawSql: select (floor(capacity_price_eur_mwh/2)*2)::int as "price from (EUR)", sum(allocated_capacity_mw)/count(distinct date_from) as "MW per block" from regelleistung.afrr_anonyme_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='$area' and product like '$dir%' and capacity_price_eur_mwh >= 0 and capacity_price_eur_mwh < 60 group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Accepted capacity per 2 EUR price class (anonymised bid lists, prices below 60 EUR), averaged per block. Shows how much capacity is awarded at which price level.

panels.title: aFRR allocated capacity by country (bid lists)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), area as metric, sum(allocated_capacity_mw)/nullif(count(distinct date_from),0) as "MW" from regelleistung.afrr_anonyme_ergebnisse_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and product like '$dir%' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Allocated capacity of the selected direction by country of the bidder, from the anonymised bid lists.

panels.title: aFRR energy demand (15 min)

targets.rawSql: select ((delivery_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') + (substring(product from 5)::int - 1) * interval '15 minutes') as time, left(product,3) as metric, demand_mw as "MW" from regelleistung.afrr_bedarfe_regelarbeit where $__timeFilter(delivery_date) and area='TOTAL' order by 1,2

panels.description: Demand for balancing energy per quarter hour product (POS = upward, NEG = downward). Time axis derived from delivery_date and the product number (DST days are approximate).

panels.title: aFRR offered energy bids (15 min)

targets.rawSql: select ((delivery_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') + (substring(product from 5)::int - 1) * interval '15 minutes') as time, left(product,3) as metric, sum_of_offered_capacity_mw as "MW" from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelarbeit where $__timeFilter(delivery_date) and area='DE' order by 1,2

panels.description: Total volume of the energy bids on the merit order list per quarter hour in Germany.

panels.title: aFRR energy price: lowest and average offer

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(t,$__interval), metric, avg(p) as "EUR/MWh" from (select ((delivery_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') + (substring(product from 5)::int - 1) * interval '15 minutes') as t, left(product,3) || ' min' as metric, min_energy_price_eur_mwh as p from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelarbeit where $__timeFilter(delivery_date) and area='DE') x group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select $__timeGroupAlias(t,$__interval), metric, avg(p) as "EUR/MWh" from (select ((delivery_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') + (substring(product from 5)::int - 1) * interval '15 minutes') as t, left(product,3) || ' average' as metric, average_energy_price_eur_mwh as p from regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelarbeit where $__timeFilter(delivery_date) and area='DE') x group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Mean of the published minimum and average energy price of the merit order list. Note: the 'average' covers the whole offered list, not only activated energy, and NEG prices are mostly negative; marginal prices sit at the +/-15000 EUR/MWh price limit in nearly all rows and are therefore not shown.

panels.title: aFRR bid prices by payment direction (volume weighted)

targets.rawSql:
select delivery_date::timestamptz as time, left(product,3) || ' ' || energy_price_payment_direction as metric, sum(energy_price_eur_mwh*allocated_capacity_mw)/nullif(sum(allocated_capacity_mw),0) as "EUR/MWh"
from regelleistung.afrr_anonyme_ergebnisse_regelarbeit where $__timeFilter(delivery_date) and area='DE' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Volume weighted daily mean of the bid energy prices from the anonymised lists, by product direction and payment direction (GRID_TO_PROVIDER = TSO pays provider, PROVIDER_TO_GRID = provider pays). Based on the bid list; how much of it was actually activated is not part of the data.
